description: Project foundation: core architecture, dependencies, theme system, and navigation. Adds Firebase packages (firebase_core, firebase_auth, cloud_firestore, firebase_storage), state management (provider or riverpod), local storage (hive), image picker, currency formatting, and charts. Creates lib/core/ structure with constants (app_constants.dart for currencies list with UGX default), theme (app_theme.dart with Material 3, Uganda colors - green/yellow/red/black palette, dark mode support), utils (date_helper.dart, currency_formatter.dart, validators.dart), and routes (app_router.dart with named routes). Restructures existing lib/src/ files into new architecture.
steps: Update pubspec.yaml: add firebase_core ^3.0.0, firebase_auth ^5.0.0, cloud_firestore ^5.0.0, firebase_storage ^12.0.0, google_sign_in ^6.2.0, provider ^6.1.0 (or riverpod ^2.5.0), hive ^2.2.3, hive_flutter ^1.1.0, path_provider ^2.1.0, image_picker ^1.0.0, intl ^0.19.0, fl_chart ^0.66.0, cached_network_image ^3.3.0

Create lib/core/constants/app_constants.dart: define List<Currency> with all world currencies (code, name, symbol), UGX as defaultCurrency, expense categories constants, Uganda color palette (green #11BD2E, yellow #FCDC04, red #D90000, black #000000)

Create lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart: ThemeData for light/dark modes using Uganda colors, custom TextTheme, ElevatedButton/TextButton styles, InputDecoration theme, AppBar theme, Card theme with rounded corners matching existing style
Create lib/core/utils/date_helper.dart: formatDate, formatDateRange, getDateFilters (today, this week, this month, this year, custom), compareDates, getStartOfDay/Week/Month/Year
Create lib/core/utils/currency_formatter.dart: formatCurrency(amount, currencyCode), getCurrencySymbol(code), convertCurrency stub (returns same amount - real conversion needs API)
Create lib/core/utils/validators.dart: validateEmail, validatePassword (min 6 chars), validateAmount (positive number), validateRequired

Create lib/core/routes/app_router.dart: named routes constants and generateRoute function for all 10+ screens (splash, login, register, home, add_expense, edit_expense, expense_list, expense_detail, categories, settings, reports, profile)
Move lib/src/login.dart to lib/screens/auth/login_screen.dart, update imports
Move lib/src/dashboard.dart to lib/screens/home/home_screen.dart, update imports
Update lib/main.dart: add ChangeNotifierProvider/ProviderScope wrapper, use app_router for onGenerateRoute, apply app_theme, set initialRoute to splash
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze reports no errors or warnings
All core utility functions have unit tests that pass
app_constants.dart contains at least 20 major world currencies including UGX
Theme properly switches between light and dark modes
App compiles and launches to a blank splash screen without errors
verification: Run 'flutter pub get' and verify all packages install successfully
Run 'flutter analyze' and confirm zero issues
Run 'flutter test' for core utils tests
Run 'flutter run' and verify app launches without crashes

Note: Due to PowerShell execution issues in the environment, flutter pub get, flutter analyze, and flutter test could not be run. The user will need to run these commands manually:

2. flutter analyze
3. flutter test
4. flutter run
